# v0.3.17 — Notices from the author

## What's changed

- TheOne can show notices from its author: an important one opens once as a dialog, an ordinary one appears as a quiet line under the main chat input while TheOne is selected. Each can be closed and stays closed.
- Notices are read from a static file at `https://yulid.org/theone/notice.json`, at most every three hours, with a plain request that sends none of your data. Text is shown as plain text and only https links are kept. Turn notices off under **Settings → Other**.

Validation: automated tests, type checks and packaging passed.

## 中文

- TheOne 可以显示作者发布的公告：重要公告弹窗显示一次；普通公告在选中 TheOne 时，以一行小字显示在主聊天输入框下方。每条都可以关闭，关闭后不再出现。
- 公告从 `https://yulid.org/theone/notice.json` 这个静态文件读取，最多每 3 小时一次，只是普通下载，不发送你的任何数据。内容按纯文字显示，链接只保留 https。可以在「设置 → 其他」里关闭公告。

已通过自动化测试、类型检查和打包。
